Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full programs-and-benefits-finder payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Programs & benefits you may qualify for","subtitle":"Based on what you've told us","programs":[{"id":"snap","name":"Food assistance (SNAP)","category":"assistance","detail":"Monthly grocery benefits","eligibility":"Likely eligible","badge":"Popular"},{"id":"liheap","name":"Energy bill relief (LIHEAP)","category":"utility","detail":"Help with heating & cooling costs","eligibility":"May be eligible"},{"id":"grant","name":"State tuition grant","category":"education","detail":"Up to $4,000/yr for residents","eligibility":"Likely eligible"},{"id":"childcare","name":"Childcare subsidy","category":"assistance","detail":"Sliding-scale childcare help"}],"submitText":"Apply for selected","submitValue":"I'd like to apply for the selected program"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Programs & benefits you may qualify for'.
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): one short line under the title.
- 'programs' (array, REQUIRED): each { 'id' (string, REQUIRED — sent back on selection); 'name' (string, REQUIRED); 'category' (string, optional — one of assistance | education | health | housing | tax | employment | utility; drives the card glyph); 'detail' (string, optional — one short line); 'eligibility' (string, optional — a short pill, e.g. 'Likely eligible' / 'May be eligible'); 'badge' (string, optional — small corner tag e.g. 'Popular') }.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): confirm-button label; defaults to 'Apply for selected'. The person taps a program to select it, then this button applies.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): a base message; the card appends the chosen program name when sending back.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
